proposed_comments.title: Segment table output using OCR word bounds

confidence.rationale: Line-only segmentation cannot preserve multiple detected columns when the OCR engine returns them within one line.

proposed_comments.body:
### Segment table output using OCR word bounds

**Severity:** `high`

Table extraction currently relies on OCR line boundaries. A row containing multiple columns within one OCR line can therefore collapse into a single cell instead of producing tab-separated columns. Please derive table cells from the OCR word bounds, retain their spatial ordering, and add focused coverage for a multi-column row represented by one OCR line.

proposed_comments.title: Avoid NativeAOT-unsafe WinRT vector enumeration

confidence.rationale: Indexed WinRT collection access avoids iterator activation paths that can fail in the NativeAOT application.

proposed_comments.body:
### Avoid NativeAOT-unsafe WinRT vector enumeration

**Severity:** `high`

The OCR and language paths enumerate WinRT vectors through iterator-based APIs that are unsafe in this NativeAOT application and can fail during activation or recognition. Please switch these paths to indexed access over the WinRT collection and cover both OCR result traversal and language selection.

proposed_comments.title: Retry the initial clipboard write when the clipboard is busy

confidence.rationale: The flush path handles transient clipboard contention, while the initial SetContent path can still lose a capture on the same error.

proposed_comments.body:
### Retry the initial clipboard write when the clipboard is busy

**Severity:** `medium`

The clipboard flush path retries transient `CannotOpenClipboard` failures, but the initial `SetContent` operation does not. A short-lived clipboard owner can therefore drop the OCR capture before the retry logic is reached. Please apply the same bounded retry behavior to the initial write and add a focused contention test.

proposed_comments.title: Base local control styles on the WinUI defaults

confidence.rationale: Replacing rather than inheriting the default styles can omit built-in keyboard, pointer, disabled, and accessibility visual states.

proposed_comments.body:
### Base local control styles on the WinUI defaults

**Severity:** `medium`

The local button and toggle styles replace the WinUI defaults instead of inheriting from them. That can discard built-in keyboard, pointer, disabled, and accessibility state behavior. Please base these styles on the corresponding default WinUI styles and override only the properties required by the overlay.

proposed_comments.title: Clean up partially created overlay resources on failure

confidence.rationale: Constructor and shutdown failures can leave an overlay or native-event cancellation source alive beyond its intended lifetime.

proposed_comments.body:
### Clean up partially created overlay resources on failure

**Severity:** `medium`

The constructor and shutdown failure paths do not consistently close a partially created overlay or dispose the native-event cancellation source. Please make cleanup unconditional and idempotent so failed initialization and partial shutdown cannot retain windows, event listeners, or cancellation resources.

proposed_comments.title: Verify every required PowerOCR binary

confidence.rationale: Checking only the PRI file allows an incomplete installation to pass even when required executables or libraries are absent.

proposed_comments.body:
### Verify every required PowerOCR binary

**Severity:** `low`

The installation verifier currently fails for a missing PRI file but can still pass when required PowerOCR WinUI 3 executables or libraries are absent. Please include the complete required binary set in the verification so partial packaging failures are detected.
